s1.desc: a plain pale grey room with a round dinner table draped in a white cloth

spans.notes: life without her: Pax alone at a bare table, desaturated, with a heavy dark grey radial vignette over the whole picture

spans.view: with bowls of pasta, two lit candles and a vase of flowers on the table between them

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit facing each other over their bowls, Polly smiling brightly while Pax eats
Polly waves a flipper in the air with a fork in the other, talking with her eyes closed while Pax grins
Pax laughs with his eyes squeezed shut and little tears at their corners while Polly giggles behind her flipper
Pax opens his eyes and looks up, still laughing, while Polly giggles behind her flipper
Pax turns his head aside and covers his beak with a flipper, giggling, while Polly keeps laughing
Pax flaps a flipper toward Polly with his beak open while she giggles behind her flipper
Pax blushes with rosy cheeks and smiles shyly across the table while Polly watches him with a flipper at her beak

spans.notes: candle glow is in-world; the table hides them below the chest | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_0): Pax's laugh with squeezed eyes starts at f124 (not f130) and his eyes are open again f148-155 inside the 130-154 beat; the flipper-flap is f166-175 (beat 154-170 ends with his eyes open and flipper out); from f176 Pax only blushes and looks across with a closed beak, not a grin
